categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the industrial software sector, focusing on CAD-related software development and sales. Its product portfolio includes 2D CAD, 3D CAD, BIM software, and cloud-based CAD solutions. It also provides internet advertising services based on its CAD cloud products. The company serves both enterprise and individual users with diversified software products and services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies in CAD software, including high-performance memory management, GPU acceleration, distributed graphic data processing, version control, and cloud-native CAD architecture. It develops software compatible across multiple operating systems (Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, HarmonyOS) and supports extensive APIs for secondary development. The company integrates cloud computing, AI, and collaborative design technologies to enhance product capabilities and user experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span mechanical manufacturing, electronics, municipal planning, construction, water conservancy, automotive, and power industries. The company serves over 70 central enterprises in China and numerous well-known domestic and international enterprises. Its products cater to both domestic and global markets, including over 175 countries and regions, with a strong presence in Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a comprehensive domestic sales and R&D network covering major economic regions. It has established a global sales network with over 70 overseas distributors covering countries such as South Korea, Japan, Poland, Brazil, Thailand, Turkey, UAE, Italy, Portugal, and India. It also has subsidiaries in Singapore and Beijing to support international expansion and innovation.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the industrial software supply chain, focusing on software development, product innovation, and cloud platform services. It provides core CAD software products and cloud-based solutions that serve as foundational tools for downstream manufacturing and construction enterprises.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core CAD technology, expanding 3D CAD and BIM product lines, and advancing cloud-based CAD platforms. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on autonomous innovation, cloud-native architecture, AI integration, and collaborative design systems. It pursues both organic growth and acquisitions, such as the purchase of Hungary's CadLine to enhance BIM capabilities. The company also emphasizes ecosystem partnerships and international market development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple models: perpetual software licenses, subscription-based licensing, and technical component licensing for CAD software. Cloud business revenue comes from membership fees for individual users and subscription or licensing fees for enterprise users. Additionally, the company earns income from internet advertising services embedded in its cloud CAD applications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global CAD software giants such as Autodesk, Dassault Systèmes, Siemens, and PTC. It positions itself as a leading domestic CAD software provider with growing international presence, focusing on breaking foreign technology monopolies in 2D CAD and expanding into 3D CAD and BIM markets. Its cloud-based CAD solutions and multi-mode licensing provide differentiation in the competitive landscape.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 289 million, a 3.93% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 62.99 million, up 16.37%. It maintains a high gross margin (~92%) and invests nearly 30% of revenue in R&D. The company has a workforce of 768 employees, with 39% in R&D, and continues to expand its global footprint and product offerings steadily.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes autonomous core technology development, high compatibility with international CAD standards, and multi-platform support including domestic operating systems and CPUs. Its cloud-native CAD solutions enable cross-terminal collaboration and data interoperability. The company offers flexible licensing models catering to diverse customer needs and integrates AI and cloud technologies to enhance design efficiency and user experience. Its strong local service network and global distribution channels further differentiate it from competitors.
